preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line.
The first line contains an integer N (1 <= N <= 10) representing the number of categories.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+N])
preconditions.description: Each of the next N lines contains at least one word (the category name).

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() or c.isspace() for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: All words in the input consist solely of lowercase letters a-z and spaces.

preconditions.expression: all(len(word) <= 30 for line in stdin.splitlines() for word in line.split())
preconditions.description: Every word in the input has a length of at most 30 characters.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == len([name for name, count in scores.items() if count == max(scores.values())]) if scores else 0
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of categories with the maximum match count.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines() == sorted([name for name, count in scores.items() if count == max(scores.values())]) if scores else []
postconditions.description: The output lines contain exactly the names of the categories with the highest number of word matches, sorted lexicographically.

postconditions.expression: all(name in category_names for name in stdout.strip().splitlines()) if stdout.strip() else True
postconditions.description: Every output line is a valid category name defined in the input.
